scripts.lint: eslint src web shared scripts test e2e *.ts
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply PREVIEW_DB --remote --config wrangler.preview-migrations.toml && wrangler preview
